Thank you for joining our CalEndow Live with @GeorgeTakei! 

Join us for the next digital event, featuring @aliciagarza, on July 22, 2021.

RSVP: https://t.co/GrwEPhDWxq
#BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/c8Mz68Xwal

On this day, we remember #PhilandoCastile whose life was taken in a police shooting just days shy of his 33rd birthday.

Someone's son, a best friend, partner, a human being. 

This is why we continue to fight. May you rest in power.

#BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/VK6M9q35wP

Yesterday marked 5 years since we lost Alton Sterling at the hands of police.

Together, we can turn our pain & outrage into action. 

We must use our #PeoplePower to stand up for those who were denied their right to live. 

#BlackLivesMatter. Rest in power, King. 👑 https://t.co/b6h9yiLboq

#SayHerName

The story of Sandra Bland reminds us of the cost of corruption, racism and injustice. The price of a life is too high a price to pay.

Rest in power, Queen.

#BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/Reze3LZHrr

Rest in power, #EricGarner.

In 2014, Eric Garner was put in a deadly & illegal chokehold by NYPD for suspicion of selling loose cigarettes.

Let's continue to fight for a society where we don't have to write remembrance posts to honor another Black life lost.

#BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/HieU2ODcz0

7/22, 2018, 18 year old #NiaWilson was killed in a racially-motivated attack at the hands of a man wielding a knife.

Described as "beautiful inside & out," we honor & lift Nia in that light.🕯

Let's continue to rise up for a more loving, just & humane society.
#BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/D7fMMxWmhA

Calling all organizers and social justice advocates! 

Tonight, 7/22, @aliciagarza will answer your questions and discuss how social media can help grow social movements—or destroy them.

Find more deets and RSVP: https://t.co/GrwEPhmlFS 

#BlackLivesMatter #CalEndowLive https://t.co/2qJ3QpEu4d
We’re kicking off today’s #CalEndowLive, moderated by @CalEndow President’s Youth Council’s Kimberly Gudino and Natalie Martinez, featuring @aliciagarza of #BlackLivesMatter! https://t.co/RXlbrcCP0l

.@aliciagarza is widely known as a co-creator of @Blklivesmatter. Her work has literally changed culture & the world.

"So much of what we were trying to do is to get people to pay attention about the things we care about."

https://t.co/zEJHAWYhHK
#BlackLivesMatter #CalEndowLive https://t.co/zHs8I4wflw

"We are having unprecedented conversations about policy. We have changed the conversation about who we are. We are moving the needle and making a difference, but we can't stop fighting." -@aliciagarza 

#BlackLivesMatter #CalEndowLive https://t.co/zwQfsoChsU

On August 9, 2014, #MikeBrown was fatally shot by a police officer in the city of Ferguson, Missouri. 💔

Let us continue the fight for justice in his honor, lift his family in strength and healing and continue to affirm that #BlackLivesMatter. 

Always have and always will. ✊🏾 https://t.co/IJXAh4gkt6

Happy heavenly 32nd bday, Freddie Gray.🙏🏾 

Following his arrest, Gray was recklessly transported by police van with no regard for his safety. He sustained serious injuries & died days later.

Justice would be Freddie celebrating another year of life today.🎈 

#BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/aOD65vmJyU
Shoutout to these amazing men and their families. #PeoplePower is when we come together for healing, health and hope. #BlackLivesMatter now and always.
This is long overdue accountability for the life of sweet Elijah. He should be here. #BlackLivesMatter
